checks.label: Address-to-parcel match
checks.processing_specification: Normalise address; reconcile address/parcel links and aliases; require unambiguous entity before dependent joins.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold dependent findings; request address/plan confirmation.

checks.label: House and ownership form
checks.processing_specification: Distinguish detached house, unit-title house and apartment; keep dwelling form separate from legal ownership.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Mark ownership form unresolved; do not assume detached appearance means standalone title.

checks.label: Dwelling footprint attribution
checks.processing_specification: Link the actual dwelling to its parcel; separate sheds, garages, roof outline and habitable footprint.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Use parcel-level screening only and label building-level exposure unknown.

checks.label: Boundary and survey concordance
checks.processing_specification: Compare mapping with authoritative plans; record positional uncertainty and resolve material mismatches.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not give exact boundary-distance conclusions without adequate geometry.

checks.label: Mapped flood-extent intersection
checks.processing_specification: Intersect valid geometry under the documented CRS; distinguish positive-area overlap, boundary touch, non-overlap and indeterminate alignment; report parcel and dwelling findings separately.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: If model coverage or identity is uncertain, report not assessed rather than no flood risk.

checks.label: Sensitivity to flood-map boundary
checks.processing_specification: Assess whether mapping uncertainty could change the intersection result; use evidence-based tolerances.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold definitive inside/outside conclusion where tolerance is unknown or material.

checks.label: Numerical flood-depth evidence
raw_inputs: Numerical flood model or specialist report
checks.processing_specification: Use validated numerical data or a scoped report; never convert map tile colours into exact depths.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Keep depth unknown until numerical model/report and datum are available.

checks.label: Surface-water and drainage condition
checks.processing_specification: Extract observed drainage defects and scope; distinguish stormwater/overland flow from mapped river flooding.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No riverine map intersection does not clear drainage risk; request inspection.

checks.label: Terrain and low-point context
checks.processing_specification: Derive terrain context at supported resolution; check age and alterations; do not infer water depth.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Mark terrain analysis unavailable or stale; no invented flow path.

checks.label: Finished-floor clearance evidence
checks.processing_specification: Calculate clearance only where level definitions, datum and event align.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold calculation if either level or datum is missing; ground elevation is insufficient.

checks.label: Official bushfire-prone designation
checks.processing_specification: Intersect the correct designation layer and retain its category/date; boundary-only or uncertain alignment creates a review gap rather than a definitive designation finding.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Missing layer/coverage is not absence of fire exposure.

checks.label: Site-specific fire resilience evidence
checks.processing_specification: Separate official area designation from site-specific assessment and mitigation evidence.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not derive BAL or loss probability from the area map alone.

checks.label: Ground movement and geotechnical concerns
checks.processing_specification: Extract verified soil/ground findings and their scope; link structural observations without diagnosing from imagery.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown without suitable report; slope or nearby cracks alone do not establish subsidence.

checks.label: Contamination and remediation evidence
checks.processing_specification: Reconcile parcel aliases and current/historical records; preserve remediation conditions.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No register match does not clear contamination; request formal search where material.

checks.label: Loose-fill asbestos history and other asbestos evidence
checks.processing_specification: Match current and historical addresses; retain deregistered history; keep other asbestos assessment separate.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Negative register match does not prove no asbestos or no undiscovered loose fill.

checks.label: Future heat, rainfall and fire-weather context
checks.processing_specification: Summarise model scenarios and ensemble range at supported geography; align horizon with buyer holding period.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: If access/model metadata is missing, keep future quantitative claims unavailable.

checks.label: Title or lease conflict with intended use
checks.processing_specification: Extract restrictions with source pages; compare with explicit intended use; flag for professional interpretation.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No title/lease means legal fit incomplete; do not clear intended use.

checks.label: Easements, encumbrances and access rights
checks.processing_specification: Link registered instruments to affected land and intended works without inventing easement geometry.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown scope stays unresolved until instrument/plan review.

checks.label: Current zoning and statutory development controls
checks.processing_specification: Combine spatial zone with legal provisions; distinguish current entitlement from proposed change.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Map zone alone cannot establish permission; hold conclusion when legal controls are absent.

checks.label: Approval and built-form discrepancies
checks.processing_specification: Compare authorised documents with observed built form; treat discrepancies as verification triggers.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Absence of a retrieved plan is not proof of illegal work; request records.

checks.label: Material structural defects
checks.processing_specification: Extract actual findings with page references and inspector qualifications; preserve inaccessible areas.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No inspection or inaccessible component remains not assessed.

checks.label: Moisture, roof and waterproofing defects
checks.processing_specification: Separate observed moisture from suspected causes; retain test limits and repair evidence.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Photos alone cannot clear concealed damage; request targeted inspection.

checks.label: Timber pests and termite-management evidence
checks.processing_specification: Extract current activity, damage and prevention evidence without treating past treatment as clearance.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Missing/incomplete inspection means pest condition unknown.

checks.label: Immediate repair and maintenance burden
checks.processing_specification: Separate urgent repairs from lifecycle maintenance; use documented quotations or labelled estimates and avoid duplicate work items.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Unpriced material defects remain material uncertainty; do not enter zero cost.

checks.label: Available cover and exclusions
checks.processing_specification: Compare reviewed policy terms with buyer requirements; distinguish one refusal from market-wide insurability.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Insurability unknown without current suitable evidence; never infer from hazard map alone.

checks.label: Comparable premium and excess burden
checks.processing_specification: Compare only materially similar cover/input combinations; retain quote validity and unpriced exclusions.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No generic suburb premium substituted for actual quote; show missing cost.

checks.label: Rebuild-cover adequacy
checks.processing_specification: Compare like-for-like rebuild scope; keep land value and market price out of rebuild-cost basis.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No rebuild estimate means adequacy unknown; sale price is not a replacement.

checks.label: Common-property defects and disputes
checks.processing_specification: Activate for applicable shared-title houses/units; link shared defects to unit exposure without assuming liability amounts.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Missing required scheme records means assessment incomplete, even if detached-house appearance.

checks.label: Owners-corporation funding and special levies
checks.processing_specification: Compare planned works with funds and documented obligations; distinguish current levy from adequate future funding.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Low levies alone are not positive evidence; unresolved funding stays unknown.

checks.label: Relevant nearby development and status
checks.processing_specification: Deduplicate application versions; match relevant land and actual proposal scope; separate approved from constructed.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No retrieved DA does not establish no future or exempt development.

checks.label: Potential sunlight, outlook and privacy change
checks.processing_specification: Use verified geometry/modelling where available; flag a relevant northern proposal without inventing lost sunlight hours.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Keep daylight/privacy impact unresolved if geometry, orientation or plan quality is insufficient.

checks.label: Proposed versus effective planning change
checks.processing_specification: Link draft and final instruments; distinguish consultation, interim effect, approval and commencement.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not apply proposed permissions as current law; unresolved status labelled.

checks.label: Strategic growth and land-release exposure
checks.processing_specification: Identify nearby prospective change; compare annual plans for deferrals and scope revisions.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Unmapped/uncertain proposals remain regional context; no promised delivery.

checks.label: Project delivery evidence and timing
checks.processing_specification: Maintain parallel lifecycle dimensions; link aliases and superseded notices; detect deferral/cancellation.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Missing milestone evidence remains unknown; announcement is not commitment or completion.

checks.label: Useful accessibility improvement
checks.processing_specification: Compare usable access/travel scenarios using documented assumptions; account for barriers, transfers and horizon.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: If routing or service assumptions lack support, describe qualitative potential only.

checks.label: Construction disruption and operating amenity impacts
checks.processing_specification: Separate temporary works from ongoing operation; cite relevant plans and evidence scope.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not invent noise levels or traffic counts from distance alone.

checks.label: Net comparable development pipeline
checks.processing_specification: Link repeated project records; subtract known removals; report proposed/approved/commenced/completed separately.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Unverified completion remains unverified; no double counting or oversupply declaration.

checks.label: Approvals intensity against dated stock
checks.processing_specification: Align boundaries/type/time; use rolling totals and label stock age; do not treat approvals as delivery.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Suppress ratio when denominator/type match is inadequate; show raw contextual counts.

checks.label: Regional construction conversion and delay
checks.processing_specification: Assess regional pipeline progression using actual series definitions and revisions.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No suburb completion estimates fabricated from ACT totals.

checks.label: Evidence for scarcity versus low turnover
checks.processing_specification: Distinguish structural constraints, few listings and low transaction activity; assess nearby substitutes.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not declare shortage when current listings, demand or stock coverage is absent.

checks.label: Population and migration trajectory
checks.processing_specification: Use consistent boundaries and multi-year change; retain preliminary/revised status and observation age.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not present annual lagged population as current-month observation.

checks.label: Household-formation scenario
checks.processing_specification: Compare future population divided by assumed household size with baseline; retain scenario source and uncertainty.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not downscale regional projections to suburbs without an explicit validated method.

checks.label: Employment resilience and concentration
checks.processing_specification: Separate modelled local unemployment from observed regional employment; use smoothed/year-on-year context and concentration.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not derive employment from SALM or treat local industry mix as individual income certainty.

checks.label: Comparable-sale evidence quality
checks.processing_specification: Select comparable settled sales with explicit exclusions, differences and sample size; verify rights/access first.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Documentation-only API access supplies no prices; missing transactions means valuation unavailable.

checks.label: Purchase-price position against evidence
checks.processing_specification: Use a transparent supported comparison range; avoid treating asking price or model estimate as ground truth.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold precise premium/discount if comparables or adjustments are inadequate.

checks.label: Resale liquidity and exit evidence
checks.processing_specification: Measure turnover on matching geography/type; use time-on-market only from genuine listing observations.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Sale dates alone do not establish time-on-market; no hidden listing API assumed.

checks.label: Rental income evidence and scope
checks.processing_specification: Keep property evidence separate from regional bond context; calculate net rental scenarios only with declared costs.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: ACT aggregates do not prove suburb/property rent or vacancy; missing property evidence stays unknown.

checks.label: Offence-specific crime context
checks.processing_specification: Use multi-period trends, small-count caution and commercial/residential context; preserve revisions.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Stale/missing crime data is unknown, not zero; suppress unstable unsupported rate claims.

checks.label: School eligibility and catchment change
checks.processing_specification: Check address and year against official PEA; record shared-zone caveats and announced changes.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not infer eligibility from proximity or guarantee preferred school in a shared zone.

checks.label: Existing public transport usefulness
checks.processing_specification: Assess scheduled usefulness for relevant days/times; keep walking-network and reliability evidence separate.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Without approved feed/routing access use dated timetable/manual evidence; no invented travel times.

checks.label: Road-crossing and crash context
checks.processing_specification: Aggregate appropriate multi-year observations near actual access routes; flag approximate points and exposure limits.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No crash/traffic exposure data means context incomplete; distance alone cannot quantify risk.

checks.label: Thermal rating and assessment validity
checks.processing_specification: Verify report/method; keep envelope, Whole of Home and actual bills distinct; assess currency.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Listing stars without source remain unverified; no conversion between incompatible scales.

checks.label: Canopy and shade context
checks.processing_specification: Retain actual survey vintage and height definition; distinguish area canopy from property shade.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not infer house temperatures, exact shade hours or young-tree absence from regional canopy.

checks.label: Measured noise or air-quality evidence
checks.processing_specification: Record measured and self-reported evidence separately; preserve sampling limits and source competence.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: No verified public noise/air adapter in source set; do not infer levels from traffic, canopy or distance.

checks.label: Macro rates and actual borrowing terms
checks.processing_specification: Show macro context separately from contractual buyer rate; retain product and fixation dates.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Cash target is not the buyer mortgage rate; no offer means declared scenario only.

checks.label: Baseline monthly affordability
checks.processing_specification: Calculate appropriate repayment schedule and complete monthly cash flow; keep assumptions visible and avoid counting principal twice.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Incomplete costs/income cannot produce a definitive pass; record missing inputs.

checks.label: Rate-rise cash-flow stress
raw_inputs: Scenario start and duration in months
checks.processing_specification: Apply disclosed stress increments to relevant loan periods over the named duration; calculate monthly cash balances and assess any reserve breach within that horizon.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: If loan terms or reserve policy are missing, withhold pass/fail and request values.

checks.label: Income-loss and emergency-buffer stress
checks.processing_specification: Simulate declared duration/amount of income loss with accessible cash only; reflect fixed obligations.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not assume redraw/credit is available cash without evidence; show incomplete scenario.

checks.label: Full ownership-cost burden
checks.processing_specification: Separate recurring, upfront and contingent costs; align timing; exclude duplicate repair/levy entries.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Unquoted material costs remain a range or unresolved gap, never zero.

checks.label: Forced-sale and equity stress
checks.processing_specification: Deferred from V0. A later exit module applies explicit price scenarios, calculates outstanding loan principal at sale from the repayment schedule and deducts sale/exit costs; no forecast probabilities are implied.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Without balance/cost assumptions show incomplete; API documentation alone is not a valuation.

checks.label: Source and observation freshness
checks.processing_specification: Evaluate freshness against native publication cadence and decision needs; separate old observation from recent retrieval.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown dates become an evidence gap; never label retrieved-today data current automatically.

checks.label: Coverage, scope and contradictions
checks.processing_specification: Track supported versus uncovered questions; preserve conflicting evidence and superseded versions; review material disagreements.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not convert missing values to safe values or average contradictions into certainty.

checks.label: Material change since previous assessment
checks.processing_specification: Distinguish real-world change, source correction and retrieval change; deduplicate repeated notices.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: If previous snapshot/coverage is absent, identify first observation rather than a new event.

checks.label: Declared objectives, horizon and non-negotiables
checks.processing_specification: Capture declared requirements and apply relevant modules; keep subjective preferences separate from factual hazards.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Do not assume preferences or tolerances; use visible defaults only as unconfirmed scenario inputs.

checks.label: Purchase funding sufficiency
raw_inputs: Confirmed applicable loan funds, conditions and dates
checks.processing_specification: Sum price, known acquisition costs and committed immediate works; subtract confirmed applicable loan and purchase cash. Preserve separate reserve allocation and unconfirmed funding conditions.
checks.missing_evidence_handling: Missing costs or unconfirmed funds prevent a fully funded conclusion; create a funding-evidence gap.
